info.title: Spectra Labs engine API
info.description: Reached only through the dashboard's server. Every /api route needs the HMAC headers X-Spectra-User, X-Spectra-Workspace, X-Request-Id, X-Spectra-Timestamp and X-Spectra-Signature (see crates/spectra-api/src/auth.rs). Timestamps are UTC RFC 3339; ids are UUIDv7; lists page with an opaque cursor.

post.summary: Upload a data file (raw bytes; at most 100 MiB).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The file's name as the person chose it (for display; at most 255 characters kept).

requestBody.description: The file's bytes. Send X-Spectra-Content-SHA256 (signed) and Content-Length.

400.description: The body does not match its declared SHA-256 or length

413.description: Over 100 MiB, or the workspace's storage quota (code `quota_exceeded`)

get.summary: Upload limits.

413.description: Over the size limit, or the storage quota (code `quota_exceeded`)

get.summary: How far a resumable upload has got.

put.summary: Send one chunk of a resumable upload.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where this chunk starts: the bytes received so far.

409.description: Not where the upload is (code `offset_mismatch`, `details.received`), or already completed

422.description: Empty, or past the file's size

post.summary: Finish a resumable upload: the file becomes an upload, ready to ingest.

201.description: Stored (a retry answers 200 with the same upload)

get.summary: Liveness.

Readiness: 200 when both the database and at least one worker answer,
otherwise 503. Compose starts the API and worker together after migrations.

200.description: The database and a worker are available

503.description: The database or worker is unavailable or not configured

BacktestListItem.description: One backtest in a list: what was asked for, its state and headline numbers.

cancel_requested.description: A cancel was asked for while it ran.

headline.description: `{total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown, final_equity, fill_count}`, once finished.

request.description: What was asked for: dataset version, strategy or strategies, params, config.

BacktestPage.description: A page of backtests, newest first.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

BacktestView.description: A backtest as the API shows it.

artifacts.description: Stored files `[{kind, file_name, content_type, sha256, size}]`, once finished.

cancel_requested.description: A cancel was asked for while it ran.

error.description: Why it failed (or the latest retryable error).

fingerprints.description: Engine, dataset, config, result and strategy hashes, once finished.

id.description: The job id (UUIDv7); use it for every `/backtests/{id}` route.

progress.description: 0..1, updated with every worker heartbeat while it runs.

request.description: What was asked for: dataset version, strategy, params, config.

summary.description: Metrics, drawdown, tail, activity and trade statistics, once finished.

BarPoint.description: One chart point. Prices are decimal numbers (for drawing only).

BarsView.description: A symbol's bars for a chart.

points.description:
At most `points` points; each groups consecutive bars (first open,
highest high, lowest low, last close, summed volume).

total_bars.description: Bars in the range, before reducing them to points.

CalendarView.description: An exchange calendar supported by the platform.

CorporateActionItem.description: A corporate action item in an upload or creation request.

dividend_amount.description: For cash dividends: dividend amount per share (e.g. "0.205").

split_from.description: For splits: original ratio (e.g. 1 in 2:1). Default: 1.

split_to.description: For splits: new ratio (e.g. 2 in 2:1). Default: 1.

CorporateActionSetDetailView.description: Detail view of a corporate action set.

CorporateActionSetSummaryView.description: Summary of a corporate action set.

CreateBacktest.description: `POST /api/v1/backtests` body: the `backtest` job payload, plus a priority.

corporate_actions.description:
Splits and dividends to apply during the run, on unadjusted prices:
`[{"symbol", "ex_date", "type": "split", "from", "to"}]` or
`[{"symbol", "ex_date", "type": "dividend", "amount"}]`.

dataset_version_id.description: A dataset version of the caller's workspace.

params.description: Strategy parameters; missing ones take their defaults.

strategies.description:
Several strategies on one account: `[{"strategy", "params", "weight"}]`,
each `weight` a share of the starting cash (adding up to at most 1).

strategy.description:
A built-in strategy name (see `GET /api/v1/strategies/builtin`).
Give either `strategy` (with `params`), `strategies`, or `strategy_version_id`.

strategy_version_id.description:
A saved strategy version (see `/api/v1/strategies`). Give it alone,
without `strategy`, `params` or `strategies`: the run uses the version's
built-in and parameters and records the version.

csv.description:
Optional CSV text containing actions with headers:
`symbol,ex_date,action_kind,split_from,split_to,dividend_amount`.

payload.description: The same body the matching synchronous route takes.

csv.description: OHLCV CSV with timestamp, symbol, open, high, low, close and volume columns.

experiment_id.description:
`POST /api/v1/runs` only: the experiment to record the run under.
Omitted: the workspace's default "Unsorted" experiment.

fast.description: Short SMA period; 1 through 999 and less than `slow`.

note.description: Optional note recorded with the run.

slow.description: Long SMA period; 2 through 1,000 and greater than `fast`.

builtin.description:
Save version 1 at once: a built-in strategy name (see
`GET /api/v1/strategies/builtin`).

name.description: Unique in the workspace; at most 200 characters.

params.description: Parameters of version 1; missing ones take their defaults.

DatasetList.description: The workspace's dataset versions, newest first.

datasets.description:
Only with `?view=grouped`: the same versions' datasets, most recently
updated first, each with its latest version (the Studio's Data tab).

DatasetSummaryView.description: A dataset, with its latest version, for the dataset list.

byte_size.description: Bytes stored for the latest version.

first_ts.description: First bar of the latest version (RFC 3339).

last_ts.description: Last bar of the latest version (RFC 3339).

updated_at.description: When the latest version was added.

DatasetVersionView.description: A dataset version a backtest can run on.

DeletedActionSetView.description: Result of deleting a corporate action set.

dataset_deleted.description: It was the dataset's last version, so the dataset was deleted too.

corporate_action_set_id.description: Corporate action set id to apply.

target_dataset_name.description: Target dataset name (defaults to source dataset name if omitted or null).

detail.description: Deprecated copy of `message`, removed with the `/api/...` aliases.

IngestColumns.description: Header names (matched without regard to case).

symbol.description: Symbol column, or null for a single-symbol file (then `default_symbol`).

volume.description: Volume column, or null if the file has none (volume is then zero).

dataset_name.description:
The dataset to add a version to (created if new). Different content
becomes its next version; the same content changes nothing.

settings.description: How to read the file (as previewed).

IngestSettings.description:
Ingest settings (the JSON form of the engine's CSV options). Every field
below without "optional" must be given: nothing is guessed.

columns.description: Which header name holds each field.

default_symbol.description: The symbol for every row when `columns.symbol` is null; not allowed otherwise.

delimiter.description: One punctuation character (not `"`) or a tab.

exchange.description: Optional exchange calendar for session enforcement and calendar-aware checks (e.g. `XNYS`, `XCME`, `XLON`, `XTKS`, `XNSE`, `24/7`).

skip_bad_rows.description: Optional, default `false`: bad rows abort the load. `true` skips and counts them.

utc_offset_minutes.description:
Minutes east of UTC for ISO timestamps written without a zone
(-720 to 840). Optional if `timezone` is provided.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last.

JobView.description: A job as the API shows it (the payload is not echoed: it can be megabytes).

cancel_requested.description: A cancel was asked for while it ran.

header.description: The header, trimmed and lower-cased (how columns are matched).

quality.description:
The quality report of the parsed rows. Every bad row in the sample is
counted here, whatever `skip_bad_rows` says.

rows.description: The first 200 parsed rows, sorted by timestamp then symbol. Prices are exact decimal text.

rows_not_read.description:
Data rows in the sample that were not checked. Every row of the
sample (at most 1 MB) is checked, so this is 0.

would_abort.description:
Why ingesting would stop with these settings (the first bad row when
bad rows abort, or "no valid data rows"); null if these rows would load.

sample.description: The start of the file as UTF-8 text, header included (at most 1 MB).

oneOf.description: Ingest settings. Omit them to get only `suggestions`.

truncated.description:
`true` when `sample` was cut from a longer file: its last line may be
incomplete, so it is ignored.

oneOf.description: The sample parsed with `settings`; null when no settings were sent.

suggestions.description: Proposals from the sample, for the person to confirm. Never applied.

QualityReport.description: A dataset's quality report (also what a dataset version stores).

bars_sha256.description: Fingerprint of the bars (recorded in backtest results).

first_ts_ns.description: First bar, nanoseconds since the epoch.

input_was_sorted.description: Whether rows arrived sorted by timestamp and symbol.

last_ts_ns.description: Last bar, nanoseconds since the epoch.

rows_rejected.description: Rows dropped (only when bad rows are skipped).

gap_factor.description: A gap is an interval longer than this many median intervals (default 5).

outlier_z.description: Robust z-score of a close-to-close return that counts as an outlier (default 10).

stale_run.description: Frozen bars in a row that count as a stale run (default 5).

horizon_days.description: Horizon in trading days, up to 7,560. Default 252.

params.description: Parameters; missing ones take their defaults.

SavedVersion.description: The result of saving a version.

created.description:
False when this code and these parameters were saved before; the
existing version is returned.

expires_at.description: Removed at this time unless more arrives (UTC, RFC 3339).

received.description: Bytes received: where the next chunk starts.

upload_id.description: The upload it became, once completed.

StrategyDetail.description: A saved strategy with every version, newest first.

StrategyVersionView.description: One immutable version of a saved strategy.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical parameter text.

current.description: True while the built-in's code is unchanged, so the version can still run.

strategy_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the built-in's source when saved (the runs' `strategy_sha256`).

Suggestions.description: Suggested settings; null where there is no confident guess.

columns.description: Header names matched by common aliases.

delimiter.description: Delimiter that splits every sampled row into the same number of fields.

header.description: The header split with that delimiter, as written.

timestamps_have_zone.description: For ISO timestamps: whether they carry a zone (then the UTC offset does not apply to them).

out_of_session_bars.description: Bars recorded outside regular exchange sessions.

stale_runs.description: Runs of `stale_run` or more frozen bars.

description.description: New description (at most 2000 characters; empty clears it).

max_bytes.description: Largest file a resumable upload accepts.

max_open_sessions.description: Unfinished uploads a workspace may have at once.

expires_at.description: Removed at this time unless ingested (UTC, RFC 3339).

chartable.description: Whether its bars can be charted here (`/bars`).

checksum.description: The dataset id (content hash of bars and symbols).

quality_report.description:
The quality report. Versions ingested through the Studio have every
field of `QualityReport`; command-line versions only some
(`rows_total`, `rows_accepted`, `rows_rejected`, `warnings`, `symbols`, ...).

source.description:
How it was made from an upload (`upload_id`, `file_sha256`, `filename`,
`settings`); null when registered from the command line.

VersionEntryView.description: One version in a dataset's history.

checksum.description: The dataset id (content hash of bars and symbols).

filename.description: Uploaded file name; null when registered from the command line.

run_count.description: Runs that used it (a version with runs can't be deleted).

VersionRunList.description: Runs of a version, newest first (at most 100).

VersionRunView.description: A run that used a dataset version.

job_id.description: The job; for a backtest, its id in `/api/v1/backtests/{id}`.

total_return.description: Total return (a fraction) for finished backtests.
